Phase 1: all trading validated here first.
Own API key pair, stored per environment.
Phase 2: enabled from Settings only after
NEVER granted to the API key.
Rollout: 1) DEMO (testnet) account for 4+ weeks — results must match backtest behaviour → 2) owner sign-off → 3) switch to LIVE in Settings (bot stopped, confirmed, small risk % first).
Start / Stop is available at any moment from the dashboard; the kill-switch flattens all positions and halts the bot instantly. Withdrawal permission is never granted to any API key.
